part_real.question: On generated motion, how far does the head joint's own rotation (invisible to the neck-to-head line) move the RULA neck input and the RULA frame class?
part_real.rows: the registered offset-reference set (develop_logs/test_runs/20261108_offset_reference/manifest.json, 2026-11-08 18:39) restricted to methods with neck and head rotations: ARDY 48, CHOIS 24, Kimodo 52, PRIMAL 96 (220 rows)

not_included.dart: the 24 DART rows of the set are legacy exports (joints only); DART native runs are not added, the set stays fixed
not_included.closd: no body rotations in the output

rotations.primal: factorial/<variant>.npz pose (transl 3 + global_orient 3 + body_pose 63 axis-angle) chained over the SMPL-X 22 tree

part_real.convention_check: pre-registration probe (2 rows per method): R_parent^T (child - parent) equals the rest-skeleton bone (cskel27 / fk_rest / somaskel77 joints.p / SMPL-X neutral betas 0) within 0.025 deg and 0 mm for neck->head, Spine3->neck (Kimodo neck->Neck2->head): global rotations are identity at rest in the joints' own frame. Per row the rest neck-to-head vector is rebuilt from the row itself as the median over frames of sum R_parent^T (child - parent) along the neck-to-head chain (the skeleton files need torch, absent from the OpenSim python). Gate per row: max over frames of the angle between the per-frame rebuild and the median <= 0.5 deg (约定，未经推演), else the row is reported as failed_convention and not used

readings.A_joint_line: ergo.neck_angles on the native joints (neck-to-head line against pelvis-to-neck; flexion, side bend), minus the revision 3 zero: what evalkit scores
readings.B_rotation: ergo.neck_angles with the head point replaced by neck + R_head_global (head_rest - neck_rest), the rest bone carried by the head joint's global rotation, minus the same zero
readings.B_minus_A: for a single neck->head bone (ARDY, CHOIS, PRIMAL) the head joint's local rotation applied to the bone; for Kimodo the Neck2 and head local rotations together

part_real.frame_match_gate: A from the native arrays must equal the evalkit source reading (biomech_sources.load, frames round(times x fps)) within 0.05 deg on every scored frame (约定，未经推演), else failed_frame_match
part_real.scoring: per row as evalkit_batch run pass 1 with the frozen offset reference (config/evalkit_offset_reference_20261108.json): fit (cached work copied from the offset-reference rows), residual contact masks, ergo.score with the RULA inputs captured; A class = evalkit class (reproduction gate: recomputed classes equal ergo.score classes on every frame); B class = the same inputs with neck_flexion_deg and neck_side_bent from B under the revision 3 rules (extension tolerance 5 deg, side bend > 10 deg); unmeasurable frames stay unmeasurable
part_real.reported: per method and pooled: B - A flexion and side bend (median, p5, p95 over frames; per-row median distribution), share of frames whose RULA neck flexion band (extension / 0-10 / 10-20 / > 20 deg) differs, RULA class transition counts A -> B, certain-risk share A vs B, rows with any class change
part_real.status: descriptive; no truth exists for generated motion, so neither reading is declared correct; evalkit scoring is not changed by this result

part_synth.question: How much of the RULA false-kill rate on the synthetic set comes from the size of the neck and head landmark offsets?
part_synth.clips: the method-floor tool runs of heldout2 + heldout3 + heldout4, v1.1 ergo pass clips (the decomposition set of the RULA supplement), each against its unchanged truth
part_synth.scales_note: factor on the drawn offsets of the neck and head landmarks only (1 = the registered 1 cm SD); 约定，未经推演
part_synth.construction: X0 = synth.export of the clip with landmark_offset_sd_m 0 and the same seed (crc32 of the clip id; the normal draws scale linearly, so jitter and floor shift are the same draws); X1 = the stored input; station positions are linear in the offset, so X_k = X0 + k (X1 - X0) on the neck and head columns and X1 elsewhere
gates: re-export with the registered SD reproduces the stored input (max abs difference <= 1e-9 m) and the SD-0 re-export has the same floor shift
scale 1 reproduces the stored tool RULA class on every frame
part_synth.scoring: tool RULA recomputed with the source X_k (ergo.score: neck and shoulder elevation come from the source; the neck point also sets the shoulder-elevation up axis, reported as a side effect); coordinates, contact and gates of the stored tool run unchanged
part_synth.reported: per scale: pooled RULA false-kill and missed-kill with the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound, per subject (10), subjects over 5%, per base task, and the tool - truth neck flexion input (median, p5, p95) on truth certain-acceptable frames
part_synth.status: descriptive; the registered RULA line, the 1 cm convention and the borderline reading stay as they are; any change of the convention is a new version decided by the user
